name: USER_HEMT
material: Generic illustrative HEMT-like electrical equations; no manufacturer or material qualification
notes: Explicit field-plate terminal. Expressions are illustrative, not a physical GaN/AlGaN or diamond compact model. No trapping, breakdown, recovery or self-heating. Numeric voltages in nonlinear functions use an implicit 1 V reference here. Supply real coefficients and qualification evidence before engineering use.
